plan: Given my private value of $16, I aim to bid strategically to maximize profit. I will bid slightly below my value to ensure potential profit while minimizing loss. The worst-case scenario is winning and paying close to my value, resulting in no profit. I will bid $15.9 to stay competitive, aiming to win if others undervalue the prize, while ensuring I don't overpay.

My value for the prize is $28. To maximize profit, I should bid slightly below my value to ensure a positive outcome if I win. Bidding exactly my value risks zero profit if I win and pay close to my bid. I will bid $27.9 to balance winning chances and profit potential. This bid ensures that even if I win, I will pay less than my value, maximizing profit.

Given my private value of $7, I aim to bid strategically to maximize profit. My bid should be below my value to ensure a profit if I win. Bidding too high risks paying more than the prize's worth. This bid considers the worst-case scenario where the third-highest bid is close to my bid, ensuring I still gain if I win.
